_note: Publishing ke hifazati switch. Har switch alag se 'true' karna padta hai — aur sirf aap ki manzoori se.
_live_enabled_note: MASTER switch. false = koi asal upload mumkin nahi (Phase 6.2 code tayyar, lekin asal upload aap ki alag manzoori ke baad).
_platforms_note: Phase 6.2: sirf YouTube (pehla test: sirf regular video; Shorts band). Facebook Reels aur TikTok code mein bhi band hain (guard.HARD_BLOCKED) — yahan true karne se bhi nahi khulenge.
_max_live_uploads_note: Kul kitne asal uploads (sab projects mila kar). 1 = sirf pehla PRIVATE test. Aage barhane ke liye aap ki nayi manzoori.
_private_only_note: true = asal upload sirf 'private'. Unlisted, public aur schedule (publishAt — jo khud public kar deta hai) band.

youtube._captions_note: false = sirf youtube.upload ijazat (force-ssl nahi maanga jaata). Captions baad mein YouTube Studio mein.
